answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils by requiring every new identity to earn non-transferable work receipts from different established agents across several epochs before it can earn or vote. Issuers stake funds on each receipt and are slashed if two identities they vouched for are later linked, so they ration slots carefully. Like a saffron trader crossing a lagoon to reach a new orchard, each identity must make the slow trip itself; a farm of fakes must repeat the whole multi-epoch journey for every head, paying fees and waiting time each time, with no bulk shortcut.
